fields.label: Year-final digit fan-out
fields.observation: MID:2548 feeds PRE:8147 and PRE:989. Saved centers include different last digits of years in dates and biographies.
fields.hypothesis: A shared MID write may encode the last position of a year-like numeral, which downstream attention could use to expect a date separator or transition.
fields.evidence:
Connected fan-out occurs in all three models on 12/14 measured anchors. Test co-firing spans 100 anchors in 33 documents. Compare identical final digits in years, quantities, identifiers and later positions while controlling the prefix. The examples are concentrated in encyclopedia prose.

fields.label: Geographic name and address routing
fields.observation: MID:4214 peaks at full place names. PRE:5139 and MID:5937 include state names and abbreviations in address or attribution contexts.
fields.hypothesis: A place-name write may feed a more specific address or state-abbreviation representation alongside a later attention read.
fields.evidence:
A same-layer MLP-gate to MLP-down branch plus a cross-layer attention branch occurs in all three models on 10/12 measured anchors. Test co-firing spans 62 anchors in 31 documents. Try full names, postal abbreviations and identical ambiguous tokens in non-geographic uses.

fields.label: Code type and identifier relay
fields.observation: MID:7001 → MID:4857 → PRE:6041 joins an MLP-up write to the same-layer MLP-down component in every model. Examples mix type names, generated class names and code identifiers.
fields.hypothesis: The intermediate may convert evidence for a type-like identifier into an attention read sensitive to its syntactic role.
fields.evidence:
Each fixed path recurs on nine anchors and the three fixed paths share eight. All 20 co-firing test documents come from GitHub or StackExchange. Compare the same identifier as a type, variable, comment and string literal. Restore the intermediate after upstream ablation to test mediation.

fields.label: Quantifying noun phrase convergence
fields.observation: MID:6335 peaks on types and kinds. MID:2599 peaks on number and variety. PRE:7189 peaks on amount and range before an of phrase.
fields.hypothesis: Two quantifier-like signals may shape a later attention read for the of-complement of a quantity or category noun.
fields.evidence:
Convergence reaches the identical downstream component per model on seven common measured anchors. Test co-firing spans 43 anchors in 29 documents. Compare quantity and non-quantity uses of “number”, and match generic noun + of controls.

fields.label: Closing-tag name fan-out
fields.observation: In the saved centers, all three gates fire on tag-name pieces after </. Examples cover several tag types.
fields.hypothesis: The shared MID write may indicate that a tag name is in closing position, feeding two query reads.
fields.evidence:
A component fan-out occurs in all three models on 7/8 measured anchors. Only two anchors support all three leading fixed forks. Compare identical tag names in opening and closing positions and use non-HTML strings containing </ as controls. The test windows are concentrated in code documents.
